What's new in Eliya Notes 1.5:
• Tables: right-click a table to add rows/columns, merge or split cells, and change cell, row and border colors
• Move a table, picture or paragraph up/down (right-click, or Control-Command-Up/Down)
• Draw with the trackpad or mouse: the new Draw button (pen, highlighter, eraser, colors)
• Boxes (Definition, Tip, Important…) fixed: no more squished boxes, and they keep their color when you reopen a note
